profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Content Developer and Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Python, PHP, C++, and Java with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from University of California, Irvine.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Designing, and building tools and processes to update, and publish developer documentation on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Documentation Website.
•	Created a toolchain, and proccess to go be able to convert all publicly documented AWS reference content from an internal DocBook-style format to AsciiDoc, a markup authoring language.
•	Engineered a solution to find, and translate, convert, and publish documentation from a internal partner network to the AWS Documentation Website, an externally avaliable documentation site, in three distinct documentation types.
•	Responsible for producing code documentation as well as team standards and conventions.

positions.title: Content Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with feature teams to design tools and processes to update and migrate the Windows Driver Kit (WDK) documentation on the Microsoft Developer Network (MSDN).
•	Created a toolchain to go through various C-style headers to extract multiple types of API and catalog them in an XML format.
•	Engineered robust, efficient solutions to find, scrape, and translate thousands of pre-documented API’s in the WDK to 6 concise types.
•	Published high-quality documentation for Storage and File System drivers by partnering with stakeholders across the Microsoft Organization.

positions.title: Arduino and Raspberry PI Lab Intern
positions.description:
•	Conceptualized and taught a Java course for High School students
•	Mentored young students using a project based format in a high-tech lab environment
•	Taught students introductory Computer Engineering and Electronics

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and deployed an original, functional feed reader application supporting key business processes to present to 6,000+ stores nationwide
•	Actively participated in an Agile Scrum development team with 2- week iterative sprints.
•	Assisted in researching, recommending, implementing, and maintaining new technologies, application software, and hardware while analyzing performance issues
